# GitHub Copilot Instructions

This repository is registered with the App Factory. Use
`.factory/repository-map.json`, `.factory/project-context.json`,
`.factory/standard-lock.json`, `docs/README.md`, and only the task-relevant
canonical documents and feature contracts before suggesting changes.

Do not introduce fake production data, disconnected controls, stale errors,
duplicate consequential actions, or unsupported completion claims.
Search `.factory/library-catalog.json` before creating generic infrastructure
and record reusable candidates in `docs/REUSABLE_COMPONENTS.md`.
